notes:
# Orvio 0.07

- Multiple playlists: add several providers in Settings and switch between them without downloading the catalog again.
- Picture-in-Picture (Settings > Playback, off by default) keeps a playing video in a small window when you leave Orvio.
- New phone player for movies and episodes: back 30 s, play/pause, forward 30 s, seek bar with time left, audio & subtitles, playback speed, fit/crop/stretch, sleep timer, episode list and next episode.
- Cast movies, episodes and Live TV to a Chromecast or Google TV. Videos a Chromecast cannot play (such as MKV) show a clear message with "Open in VLC or another player" or "Watch on this device".
- Cleaner Live TV on phones: one channel header with favorite and cast buttons, fullscreen on the video, compact search and category filters.
- Check for updates now responds immediately and shows the result.
- Fixes: Live TV no longer inherits a movie's playback speed; the sleep timer survives Picture-in-Picture; play restarts a finished video; Continue watching labels series correctly; the phone navigation bar no longer covers search results while typing; new playlists get a unique default name; TV settings show the real playlist name; navigation sounds are disabled while interface sounds are off.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
